part.text:
Fixed. The issue was `AppSettings::InferSubcommands` (src/clap_app.rs:21), which made clap match any prefix of the `cache` subcommand, so `bat c`/`cach`/etc. inferred the subcommand instead of treating the argument as a filename.

The fix (matching upstream sharkdp/bat PR #562) removes that setting, keeping only exact `cache` subcommand matches:

- `bat cache` with a `cache` file present → prints the file (`can_print_file_named_cache` passes)
- `bat cach` → no file, exits with failure (`does_not_print_unwanted_file_named_cache` passes)

Validation: all 34 integration tests pass. The 9 failing snapshot tests (`changes*`, `full`) also fail identically on the unmodified baseline — they're a pre-existing, unrelated environment issue.
